description: Stage 2: Noita reactions involving liquids and gases (materials.xml).

probability.desc: Noita probability (per contact and frame, of 100).

input3.desc: A third cell that must touch too ('none').

output3.desc: What the third cell turns into ('none').

direction.desc: Where input2 must be from input1 ('none' = any side).

blob_radius1.desc: Noita px around input1 that change with it (0 = the cell only).

blob_radius2.desc: Noita px around input2 that change with it (0 = the cell only).

blob_restrict1.desc: The blob of input1 changes only cells of input1's material.

blob_restrict2.desc: The blob of input2 changes only cells of input2's material.

req_lifetime.desc: Frames input1 must have existed (0 = any).

entity.desc: Entity file loaded where it happens ('none').
